latvia.title: Borízű hang #292: Kilencmilliárd Kisvárda határában, Harapófogó Dániel elnézést kér Kínától [rövid verzió]
latvia.description: Ki mennyit ülne Orbánért? NER-es csődhullám: Nanushka. Rogán Cili hány pont? Mbappé és a Liga becsicskul Kínának. Vas Gereben, Harapófogó Dániel, Maderspach Károlyné, öngyilkosság mozsárágyúval. A Dschingis Khan Mongóliában. Túl olcsó a benzin.

latvia.title: Nem kért bocsánatot Elon Musktól a Ryanair-vezér, helyette ismételten leidiótázta a milliárdost
latvia.description: Közölte, hogy esze ágában sincs békét kötni Muskkal.

latvia.title: Azonnali hatállyal menesztették Feledy Botondot - Reagált a Külügyi Intézet kirúgott vezérigazgatója; Magyar Péter is megszólalt az ügyben
latvia.description: Velkey György László, a Külügyminisztérium parlamenti államtitkára szűkszavú Facebook-posztban jelentette be, hogy menesztik a Magyar Külügyi Intézet nemrég kinevezett vezérigazgatóját, Feledy Botondot. Nem sokkal később Feledy Botond is reagált Facebook-posztban, elmondta: külpolitikai elemző cége a Lázár János vezette Építési és Közlekedési Minisztériumnak is dolgozott. Ezt már maga Magyar Péter miniszterelnök sem hagyta szóm nélkül, majd Feledy Botond Facebook-bejegyzése alatt beszélgetésbe fogtak egymással az érintettek. Közben az is kiderült, hogy milyen feladatokat végzett Feledy cége a volt miniszternek.

latvia.title: Olyan hajó jelent meg a NATO-hadgyakorlat közelében, amelynek nem kellett volna ott lennie
latvia.description: A brit Királyi Haditengerészet lefülelt egy NATO-hadgyakorlatot megfigyelő orosz felderítő hajót – írja a The Kyiv Independent .

latvia.title: Bejelentették: különleges műveletet indít Oroszország határán az egyik legerősebb NATO-tagállam - Fegyveres betöréstől tartanak
latvia.description: Lengyelország különleges műveletet indított az Oroszországhoz tartozó Kalinyingrádi terület határán, miután figyelmeztetést kapott esetleges szabotázsakciókról. A megelőző jellegű biztonsági intézkedésekbe a rendőrség mellett a hadsereget és a titkosszolgálatokat is bevonták - tudósított az RBK .

latvia.title: A legrosszabbra készül a NATO: Trump esetleges veresége drámai következményekkel járhat
latvia.description: A NATO európai tagállamai a legrosszabb forgatókönyvre készülnek a keddi amerikai félidős választások előtt. Diplomáciai források szerint a szövetségesek attól tartanak, hogy egy esetleges republikánus vereség után a belpolitikában megbénított Donald Trump a külpolitikában próbál majd látványos lépéseket tenni - tudósított a Politico .

latvia.title: Adam Bodnar: To stajnia Augiasza. Trzeba ją oczyścić i wyjść z zaległości
latvia.description: Nie tylko trzeba oczyścić Trybunał Konstytucyjny, czyli pokazać obywatelom, że normalnie działa, ale wyjść ze wszystkich zaległości w sposób transparentny - powiedział w "Faktach po Faktach" w TVN24 senator KO i były minister sprawiedliwości Adam Bodnar. W programie komentował najnowsze oświadczenie sędzi Anny Korwin-Piotrowskiej.

latvia.title: Ruský jadrový obor je neopraviteľný, zaznelo z Moskvy. O pár hodín ten istý muž všetko poprel
latvia.description: Jedna z najväčších bojových lodí sveta môže po takmer troch desaťročiach služby skončiť bez plánovanej modernizácie. Ruský jadrový raketový krížnik Peter Veľký (Pjotr Velikij), dlhoročná vlajková loď Severnej flotily, má byť podľa pôvodného vyjadrenia predstaviteľa námorníckej organizácie natoľko opotrebovaný, že sa jeho oprava už neoplatí. Vladimir Maľcev však ešte v ten istý deň informácie o rozhodnutí komisie poprel.

latvia.title: NATO cvičí přesun a zásobování tisíců vojáků
latvia.description: V Lotyšsku se koná dosud největší cvičení mezinárodní brigády NATO v zemi. Operace Resolute Reforger 2026 prověřuje schopnost aliančních jednotek přesouvat se na velké vzdálenosti a udržet bojeschopnost v náročných podmínkách. Do cvičení, které potrvá do 8. listopadu, se zapojilo přibližně 3 tisíce a tisíc kusů vojenské techniky. Vojáci testují logistické, zdravotnické i vojenské policejní zabezpečení jednotek v terénu. Jednou z hlavních výzev je zásobování bojových jednotek v první linii palivem, potravinami a vodou prostřednictvím sítě logistických stanovišť. Cvičení zahrnuje i operace v realistických podmínkách včetně civilních oblastí východního Lotyšska.

latvia.title: Un avion de vânătoare rusesc de ultimă generație Su-57 a sărit în aer când pornea motoarele. Care a fost cauza (GUR)
latvia.description: Un avion de vânătoare rusesc de ultimă generație, Su-57, a explodat la sfârșitul lunii octombrie pe un aerodrom militar, susține spionajul militar ucrainean. Potrivit Direcției de Informații a Ministerului Apărării din Ucraina (GUR), incidentul ar fi fost cauzat de calitatea proastă a combustibilului folosit.

latvia.title: „20 de euro pentru fiecare porc crescut în gospodărie”. Tanczos Barna anunță ajutoare pentru crescători (proiect)
latvia.description: Senatul a adoptat luni o propunere legislativă pentru sprijinirea gospodăriilor şi fermelor comerciale mici în prevenirea răspândirii pestei porcine africane, a anunţat senatorul UDMR Tanczos Barna, inițiatorul proiectului. Documentul merge la Camera Deputaţilor, for decizional în acest caz.

latvia.title: Cinci senatori aleşi pe listele POT şi S.O.S. România s-au afliat grupului PSD
latvia.description: Cinci senatori aleşi în Parlament pe listele POT şi S.O.S România şi-au anunţat, luni, în plenul Senatului, afilierea la grupul Partidului Social Democrat.

latvia.title: Trafic blocat pe ambele sensuri pe bulevardul Metalurgiei din București, după ce un copac a căzut și a doborât un stâlp electric
latvia.description: Traficul rutier este restricționat luni pe bulevardul Metalurgiei, unde un copac a căzut pe carosabil și a doborât un stâlp de electricitate, a anunțat Brigada Rutieră a Capitalei.

latvia.title: Trump caută țapi ispășitori pentru eșecul răsunător al războiului cu Iranul. Capul cui ar putea să cadă „pe altarul” liderului SUA
latvia.description: Războiul cu Iranul, care s-a prelungit mai mult de opt luni și a dus la creșterea prețurilor la combustibil în SUA până la niveluri record, i-a costat scump pe Donald Trump și pe republicani. Aceștia riscă să piardă alegerile intermediare pentru Congres, înaintea cărora președintele a promis că nu va relua acțiunile militare împotriva Iranului. Pentru perioada de după alegeri, a fost pregătit un plan de lansare a unor atacuri și mai masive asupra Iranului, care, după cum se tem țările din Golful Persic, vor duce la distrugeri și mai mari și la destabilizarea regiunii, scriu Bloomberg și Financial Times.

latvia.title: Exit-poll în Bulgaria: candidata pro-rusă Iliana Iotova conduce în alegerile prezidențiale, cu 57,4% din voturi
latvia.description: Iliana Iotova este pe cale să obțină un mandat de cinci ani la conducerea Bulgariei, potrivit primelor exit-poll-uri publicate la închiderea urnelor. Candidata susținută de formațiunea premierului Rumen Radev conduce în fața lui Andrei Ghiurov, care a mizat pe o platformă pro-occidentală și pe apropierea de UE și NATO, potrivit Novinite.

latvia.title: Un fost agent Mossad l-ar fi ajutat pe Flavio Bolsonaro să fugă din Brazilia. Cum a fost organizată operațiunea secretă (presă)
latvia.description: Un fost agent al serviciului israelian de informații Mossad l-ar fi ajutat pe senatorul brazilian Flavio Bolsonaro, fiul fostului președinte Jair Bolsonaro, să fugă din Brazilia prin Argentina, încălcând o interdicție judecătorească de a părăsi țara. Operațiunea ar fi fost pregătită înaintea turului al doilea al alegerilor prezidențiale și ar fi beneficiat de sprijinul unor persoane influente din Argentina și Statele Unite, relatează The Jerusalem Post, preluat de News.ro.

latvia.title: Marco Rubio neagă o implicare directă a Washingotnului în fuga lui Flavio Bolsonaro din Brazilia
latvia.description: Secretarul de stat american Marco Rubio a declarat sâmbătă că Washingtonul nu a fost implicat direct în aranjamentele făcute de senatorul Flavio Bolsonaro de a părăsi Brazilia după înfrângerea sa în cel de-al doilea tur al alegerilor prezidenţiale, relatează duminică AFP.

latvia.title: Obsesia Generației Z pentru ridicatul de greutăți și legătura cu Napoleon. De ce renunță tinerii la alergat pentru sala de forță
latvia.description: Peste un sfert dintre tinerii adulți din Marea Britanie spun în prezent că abonamentele la sală contează mai mult pentru ei decât vacanțele sau mâncatul în oraș. Datele Sport England arată că Generația Z a început să se îndepărteze de alergare, înot și cursuri de fitness și să se orienteze către sală și antrenamentul de forță. Pentru ei, antrenamentul cu greutăți este considerat cea mai bună formă de exercițiu, pentru că poate ajuta la dezvoltarea forței, la îmbunătățirea aspectului și la îmbunătățirea sănătății generale.

latvia.title: Simion îi convoacă pe membrii AUR la protest, pe 14-15 noiembrie / În mai multe rânduri le-a cerut susținătorilor lui Georgescu să nu renunțe la proteste
latvia.description: Dacă până în prezent s-a mulțumit să-i instige pe susținătorii pro-rusului Călin Georgescu să iasă în stradă și să nu renuțe la proteste, liderul formațiunii extremiste George Simion anunță o manifestație organizată de propriul partid, în Capitală, la jumătatea lunii noiembrie. „Pe 14 -15 noiembrie toți membrii AUR vor fi la București. Voi unde veți […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: VIDEO | Cinci senatori aleși pe listele SOS și POT s-au mutat la PSD / Între ei, Valetina Aldea care a izbucnit în râs înainte să anunțe mutarea
latvia.description: PSD are de luni cu cinci senatori mai mulți, în total 40. În plenul Senatului și-au anunțat mutarea la partidul condus de Sorin Grindeanu, Ionel Carp și Cristian Bem, aleși pe listele S.O.S. România, Valentina Aldea, Liviu Sorin Robe și Robert Daniel Ghiță, aleși pe listele POT. Toți cei cinci aleși figurau până acum în […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Latvia's insolvent Valka stops cooperation programs with Estonia's Valga
latvia.description: Cross-border cooperation projects between Estonia's Valga and Latvia's Valka have been suspended as the Latvian municipality is insolvent and must undergo a financial restructuring process.

latvia.title: Estonian border guards could be given additional powers to stop migrants
latvia.description: Estonian border guards could be given additional powers to stop border violators, Minister of Interior Igor Taro (Eesti 200) has said, after meeting with his Latvian counterpart.

latvia.title: Estonian raw milk producer buys Latvia's largest dairy company
latvia.description: Estonia's largest agricultural group, Agrone, on Friday finalized a deal to buy Latvia's largest dairy companies, Rīgas piena kombināts and Valmieras piens.

latvia.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1714. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Ukraina, USA ja Vene ametnikud kohtuvad järgmisel nädalal Abu Dhabis
latvia.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1714. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis. 2026/ukraina-kalender

latvia.title: Politico: Ukraina kaotab USA kongressis võtmeliitlasi
latvia.description: Ühendriikide kongressi vahevalimised korraldatakse teisipäeval ja sõltumata nende tulemustest lahkuvad paljud Ukrainat toetavad vabariiklased, kirjutas väljaanne Politico, mida vahendas ukrainlaste uudisteagentuur Unian.

latvia.title: Kiirabis hakkab töötama vähem arste
latvia.description: Sotsiaalministeerium plaanib vähendada arstidega kiirabibrigaadide arvu, kuna peab nende praegust hulka liiga suureks ja soovib kasutada tervishoiutöötajate ressurssi tõhusamalt. Eestis on praegu selliseid brigaade, kus töötavad nii arst kui ka õde, 13, kirjutab ERR.

latvia.title: Air threat alert in Latvia's Balvi, Ludza municipalities is over
latvia.description: Latvia's National Armed Forces (NBS) issued an orange level alert at around half past midnight on Tuesday, November 3, over a potential threat to Latvian airspace. The threat was declared over at 0:40.

latvia.title: Traffic near fire in Sarkandaugava to be restricted this week
latvia.description: On Monday morning, a fire broke out in an unoccupied building on Tvaika Street, but traffic near the building will be closed for at least a week whilst structural engineers assess the stability of the external walls and a solution is found to eliminate the hazard, the Rīga City Council has announced.

latvia.title: Latvia among EU's low spenders on social protection benefits
latvia.description: Fresh data from Eurostat suggests that potential cost-cutting measures by the incoming government will come against a background in which Latvia already has one of the lowest levels of spending on social protection in the the European Union.

latvia.title: 'Drone for Latvia, drone for Ukraine' calls fundraising campaign
latvia.description: ‘A drone for Latvia, a drone for Ukraine.’ This is the slogan for the latest fundraising campaign. Throughout November, everyone is invited to support the purchase of drones for both the Ukrainian army and the Latvian National Guard, Latvian Radio and Latvian Television reported.

latvia.title: RFS wins a fourth Latvian football league title
latvia.description: The long-time leaders of the Latvian Football League (Virslīga), RFS, defeated Grobiņa 3:0 in Riga on Sunday, November 1st, and in the process secured a fourth Latvian league title for themselves.

latvia.title: Outgoing Latvian health minister quits party after 16 years
latvia.description: Outgoing Health Minister Hossams Abu Meri has decided to resign from the Unity political party (which technically sits within the slightly borader 'New Unity' political force) according to a statement on his Facebook account.

latvia.title: Riga Airport is looking for investors
latvia.description: RIX Riga Airport has launched a competitive selection process for the development of aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) hangars on the airport's territory, it announced on November 2nd.

latvia.title: NATO demonstrates its 'digital backbone' again in Latvia
latvia.description: NATO’s Digital Backbone eXperimentation (DiBaX 2026) took place in Latvia from October 19-30, under the leadership of NATO Allied Command Transformation (ACT), supported by the Latvian Ministry of Defence and the National Armed Forces, with LMT Defence as the technicalintegrator. It is a NATO experiment aimed at enhancing interoperability across domains through cutting-edge 5G and satellite communication technologies.

latvia.title: Latvia sends 'mobile surveillance device' to eastern border
latvia.description: Latvia's National Armed Forces (NBS) have deployed a first new "mobile surveillance device" on the Latvian state border to the Krāslava region, the NBS said in a release on November 2nd.

latvia.title: Latvia plans to buy Canadian 'Hellbender' helmets
latvia.description: Latvia's National Defence Logistics and Acquisition Centre (VALIC) has agreed with Canadian defence equipment manufacturer Galvion on the supply of "tactical helmet systems" for the National Armed Forces.

latvia.title: All Latvian electric trains now have names
latvia.description: The naming of the “Vivi” electric trains has been completed – the last four have now been given their names. Passengers will be carried by Lūsis (Lynx), Dzenis (Woodpecker), Kļava (Maple) and Alnis (Moose). This means that all 32 electric trains have now been named.

latvia.title: Latvian Prime Minister Kulbergs enjoys his rally passion with weekend win
latvia.description: While the attention of most of the motorsports world over the weekend was focussed on the crowning of the youngest ever Formula 1 world champion, Kimi Antonelli, 20, at the Mexican Grand Prix, there was a slightly slower motor race being run in the suburbs of Rīga involving a slightly older but no less remarkable personality.

latvia.title: Some nights will be frosty in Latvia this week
latvia.description: There will be no major changes in the weather this week, but forecasts suggest that on some nights the temperature will dip slightly below zero.

latvia.title: Rural tourism was pretty popular this summer in Latvia
latvia.description: Rural tourism has not seen a significant drop in bookings or visitor numbers this summer, although guests have become more frugal when it comes to dining. Despite a significant rise in costs, business owners are increasing food prices cautiously, Latvian Radio reported on November 2.

latvia.title: Traffic restricted in Rīga, Sarkandaugava due to fire Monday morning
latvia.description: On Monday morning, a fire broke out in an unoccupied building on Tvaika Street in Riga, and the road has been closed at the start of the street, according to the State Fire and Rescue Service (VUGD).

latvia.title: Bauska getting a head start on Christmas tree shopping
latvia.description: Although there are still just under two months to go until Christmas, Bauska is already thinking about the festive season. Residents have decided that, after a break of several years, a real Christmas tree will once again be erected in the town’s Town Hall Square. However, the change will not take place until next year, Zemgale Regional Television reported on November 2.

latvia.title: Grass growing under Latvian AI centre's feet
latvia.description: Latvia's Artificial Intelligence Centre (MIC) was established last April. The centre’s first director, Natālija Čerņecka, was appointed to the post last October and remained in the post for four months. She was succeeded by Guna Puce, who has not yet been in the post for a year. And now, once again, there is talk of structural changes at the centre, Latvian Television's De Facto reported on November 1.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 1st November, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia takes charge of the United Nations Security Council for first time
latvia.description: November 1st, 2026 is an historic day, as for the first time ever Latvia will hold the presidency of the UN Security Council (UNSC). During this month, Latvia will chair all informal and formal UNSC meetings.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: October 31st, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Air alert in Ludza and Krāslava municipalities of Latvia is over
latvia.description: Latvia's National Armed Forces (NBS) issued a warning covering Ludza and Krāslava municipalities regarding a threat to airspace on Sunday evening at 18:57, but it was withdrawn fairly quickly.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 30th October 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Baltic defence industry gains momentum
latvia.description: The defence industry across the Baltic states is growing significantly. The number of companies and employees has increased, revenues have risen and investment is expanding. Yet the sector’s future will ultimately depend on its ability to create high-value products and succeed in export markets.

latvia.title: The deal is done: Kārums belongs to the Estonians
latvia.description: One of Latvia's best-known and best-loved brands has fallen into the hands of our wily northern neighbours, it was confirmed on Friday.

latvia.title: Report: U.S. pressures Baltics not to say nasty things about Russia
latvia.description: Pentagon officials have urged several NATO allies, including the Baltic states, to tone down their public rhetoric about the threat posed by Russia, arguing that some statements by European leaders and official have undermined the continent’s security, according to Lithuanian public media LRT, citing a Reuters report.

latvia.title: New EUR 82m overpass to open this weekend in Rīga
latvia.description: The 82 million euro Kundziņsala flyover in Rīga has been completed and will open to traffic on November 1st, it has been confirmed.

latvia.title: Fuel thief detained in Rīga
latvia.description: On 25 October, law enforcement officers in Purvciems, Rīga, arrested a man born in 1984 who is suspected of 15 incidents of fuel theft in Riga.

latvia.title: NATO minesweepers arrive in Liepāja port
latvia.description: On October 30th, two ships of the Standing NATO Maritime Mine Countermeasures Group 1 (SNMCMG1) arrived in the port of Liepāja.

latvia.title: Railways more popular in Latvia than in Estonia or Lithuania
latvia.description: New Eurostat data published on October 29th confirms that Latvians like to use their railways more than their neighbours to the north and south.

latvia.title: 'A concrete decision is needed' from Latvia on Rail Baltica
latvia.description: Rail Baltica is currently in a situation where one of the most significant risks to the future progress of the project is not technical readiness or construction capacity, but the timeliness and consistency of political decisions.

latvia.title: Heating tariffs to rise in many municipalities from November 1st
latvia.description: From November 1, heating tariffs will increase in Cēsis, Gulbene, Jelgava, Saldus, Valmiera, Dobele and Jūrmala the Public Utilities Regulatory Commission (SPRK) has announced. It has approved a heating tariff increase in November for a total of 13 regulated merchants, while a decrease has been approved for one.

latvia.title: British historian to receive Latvian state award
latvia.description: The latest selection of persons to be deemed worthy of high state awards has been revealed by the Presidential Chancellery.

latvia.title: Tele2 finalises network upgrade in Latvia
latvia.description: Mobile network operator ‘Tele2’ has completed a network modernisation project worth 27 million euros, introducing the latest technologies at almost all of its base stations, the company announced on October 30.

latvia.title: Unregistered SIM cards will be banned in Latvia
latvia.description: To curb telephone fraud and other criminal activities, users of pay-as-you-go SIM cards will also be required to register, the Saeima decided on Thursday, 29 October, when it adopted amendments to the Electronic Communications Law at its final reading.

latvia.title: Frosts expected in Latvia next week
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that the weather in Latvia will become slightly cooler next week.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: This is Halloween
latvia.description: This weekend, we have selected the spookiest, scariest events for boo!

latvia.title: Boil your tap water next week in Rīga
latvia.description: From November 2 to November 5, preventive disinfection of the water supply network will take place in Rīga, according to the water management company Rīgas ūdens.

latvia.title: Audit: Valka has spent more than it can afford
latvia.description: The town and muncipality of Valka, which has recently found itself in financial trouble, has been in the red for quite some time, according to a report by the State Audit Office published on October 30.

latvia.title: Rīga's central heating tariff to rise significantly in December
latvia.description: From 1 December, AS “Rīgas siltums”, who is responsible for Rīga's district heating plans to increase its heating tariffs by 19 per cent, Ivo Valdovskis, head of the company’s strategic communications department, told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Showers expected Friday in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that light rain is expected in parts of Latvia on Friday.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 29th October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvian border guards given clearer rights to use force and weapons
latvia.description: Latvia's parliament, the Saeima, on October 29th adopted amendments to the State Border Guard Law and the Criminal Procedure Law intended to give border guards clearer rights to act and to better protect border infrastructure from hybrid attacks,

latvia.title: Study suggests gambling ads are still a problem in Latvia
latvia.description: A research into gambling conducted by the Ministry of Finance suggests that Latvia needs to clarify existing advertising restrictions and strengthen monitoring of their compliance in order to reduce the harm caused by gambling and lotteries, especially among young people.

latvia.title: Latvian armed forces staging Jēkabpils hockey tournament
latvia.description: From October 30th to 31st, a National Armed Forces Hockey Tournament called “For Latvia!” will take place in Jēkabpils, at the Jēkabpils Sports Centre Ice Hall.

latvia.title: Latvia not particularly wasteful by EU standards
latvia.description: Latvia's environmentally friendly credentials are sometimes bad and sometimes good, depending upon what precisely is being measured. The latest data from Eurostat, published on October 29th, leans rather more towards the positive than the negative side of things.

latvia.title: Latvia to take coach certification more seriously
latvia.description: A fine has been introduced in Latvia for leading sports training sessions without the necessary qualifications. Appropriate qualifications were also previously required to teach sports, but not much could happen if there were none. The Latvian Radio programme “Open Files” investigated whether the system, whose purpose is to protect people and ensure coaches’ qualifications, actually serves this purpose in all cases.

latvia.title: Retail trade up on year in Latvia
latvia.description: According to the Central Statistical Bureau data published on October 29, retail trade turnover in September 2026 was 4.5 % higher than a year ago (calendar-adjusted data at constant prices).

latvia.title: Survey suggests Latvians quite responsible with bills
latvia.description: Just over 6 per cent of the population have outstanding debts outside the credit sector, for example, for utilities, electricity, telephone services and car parking, according to a public survey carried out by the Credit Information Bureau (KIB), which was carried out in collaboration with the research agency ‘Norstat’.

latvia.title: Estonia wants to lease trains to Latvia
latvia.description: Estonia's state-owned passenger rail operator Elron wants to modernize the trains running between Tartu and Rīga to attract more passengers to the route. It would also like to rent the trains to Latvians for use on local routes, reports Estonian public media ERR News, citing a letter the company sent to the Ministry of Climate.

latvia.title: Key Latvian financial crime fighter decides to depart
latvia.description: The head of the Financial Intelligence Unit (FID), Toms Platacis, has decided to leave the service as of December 11th, it has been announced. The FID spearheads Latvia's application of international sanctions, in addition to other areas of responsibility including preventing the use of the Latvian financial system for money laundering and the financing of terrorism and proliferation.

lithuania.description: A brit Királyi Haditengerészet lefülelt egy NATO-hadgyakorlatot megfigyelő orosz felderítő hajót – írja a The Kyiv Independent .

lithuania.description: Lengyelország különleges műveletet indított az Oroszországhoz tartozó Kalinyingrádi terület határán, miután figyelmeztetést kapott esetleges szabotázsakciókról. lithuania.title: A legrosszabbra készül a NATO: Trump esetleges veresége drámai következményekkel járhat
lithuania.description: A NATO európai tagállamai a legrosszabb forgatókönyvre készülnek a keddi amerikai félidős választások előtt. Diplomáciai források szerint a szövetségesek attól tartanak, hogy egy esetleges republikánus vereség után a belpolitikában megbénított Donald Trump a külpolitikában próbál majd látványos lépéseket tenni - tudósított a Politico .

lithuania.title: Adam Bodnar: To stajnia Augiasza. Trzeba ją oczyścić i wyjść z zaległości
lithuania.description: Nie tylko trzeba oczyścić Trybunał Konstytucyjny, czyli pokazać obywatelom, że normalnie działa, ale wyjść ze wszystkich zaległości w sposób transparentny - powiedział w "Faktach po Faktach" w TVN24 senator KO i były minister sprawiedliwości Adam Bodnar. W programie komentował najnowsze oświadczenie sędzi Anny Korwin-Piotrowskiej.

lithuania.title: Putin bude mať celú Európu ako na dlani. Rusko v Kaliningrade buduje 500-metrové monštrá
lithuania.description: V ruskej Kaliningradskej oblasti sa dokončuje veľká radarová stanica, ktorá ruskej armáde umožní detekciu lietadiel, rakiet a lodí na vzdialenosť až 3000 kilometrov. Mohla by tiež pokrývať značnú časť Európy, informuje TASR podľa stanice Deutsche Welle.

lithuania.title: Ruský jadrový obor je neopraviteľný, zaznelo z Moskvy. O pár hodín ten istý muž všetko poprel
lithuania.description: Jedna z najväčších bojových lodí sveta môže po takmer troch desaťročiach služby skončiť bez plánovanej modernizácie. Ruský jadrový raketový krížnik Peter Veľký (Pjotr Velikij), dlhoročná vlajková loď Severnej flotily, má byť podľa pôvodného vyjadrenia predstaviteľa námorníckej organizácie natoľko opotrebovaný, že sa jeho oprava už neoplatí. Vladimir Maľcev však ešte v ten istý deň informácie o rozhodnutí komisie poprel.

lithuania.title: Polsko zřídilo speciální jednotku kvůli možným ruským sabotážím
lithuania.description: Speciální jednotku zřídilo na severovýchodě svého území Polsko. Tamní policejní velitelství tak reaguje na varování rozvědky před možnými ruskými sabotážemi a vpády přes hranice. Podle agentury PAP zároveň začala bezpečnostní operace ve Varmijsko-Mazurském a Podlaském vojvodství, která hraničí s ruskou exklávou Kaliningrad.

lithuania.title: NATO cvičí přesun a zásobování tisíců vojáků
lithuania.description: V Lotyšsku se koná dosud největší cvičení mezinárodní brigády NATO v zemi. Operace Resolute Reforger 2026 prověřuje schopnost aliančních jednotek přesouvat se na velké vzdálenosti a udržet bojeschopnost v náročných podmínkách. Do cvičení, které potrvá do 8. listopadu, se zapojilo přibližně 3 tisíce a tisíc kusů vojenské techniky. Vojáci testují logistické, zdravotnické i vojenské policejní zabezpečení jednotek v terénu. Jednou z hlavních výzev je zásobování bojových jednotek v první linii palivem, potravinami a vodou prostřednictvím sítě logistických stanovišť. Cvičení zahrnuje i operace v realistických podmínkách včetně civilních oblastí východního Lotyšska.

lithuania.title: Un avion de vânătoare rusesc de ultimă generație Su-57 a sărit în aer când pornea motoarele. Care a fost cauza (GUR)
lithuania.description: Un avion de vânătoare rusesc de ultimă generație, Su-57, a explodat la sfârșitul lunii octombrie pe un aerodrom militar, susține spionajul militar ucrainean. Potrivit Direcției de Informații a Ministerului Apărării din Ucraina (GUR), incidentul ar fi fost cauzat de calitatea proastă a combustibilului folosit.

lithuania.title: „20 de euro pentru fiecare porc crescut în gospodărie”. Tanczos Barna anunță ajutoare pentru crescători (proiect)
lithuania.description: Senatul a adoptat luni o propunere legislativă pentru sprijinirea gospodăriilor şi fermelor comerciale mici în prevenirea răspândirii pestei porcine africane, a anunţat senatorul UDMR Tanczos Barna, inițiatorul proiectului. Documentul merge la Camera Deputaţilor, for decizional în acest caz.

lithuania.title: Cinci senatori aleşi pe listele POT şi S.O.S. România s-au afliat grupului PSD
lithuania.description: Cinci senatori aleşi în Parlament pe listele POT şi S.O.S România şi-au anunţat, luni, în plenul Senatului, afilierea la grupul Partidului Social Democrat.

lithuania.title: Trump caută țapi ispășitori pentru eșecul răsunător al războiului cu Iranul. Capul cui ar putea să cadă „pe altarul” liderului SUA
lithuania.description: Războiul cu Iranul, care s-a prelungit mai mult de opt luni și a dus la creșterea prețurilor la combustibil în SUA până la niveluri record, i-a costat scump pe Donald Trump și pe republicani. Aceștia riscă să piardă alegerile intermediare pentru Congres, înaintea cărora președintele a promis că nu va relua acțiunile militare împotriva Iranului. Pentru perioada de după alegeri, a fost pregătit un plan de lansare a unor atacuri și mai masive asupra Iranului, care, după cum se tem țările din Golful Persic, vor duce la distrugeri și mai mari și la destabilizarea regiunii, scriu Bloomberg și Financial Times.

lithuania.title: Exit-poll în Bulgaria: candidata pro-rusă Iliana Iotova conduce în alegerile prezidențiale, cu 57,4% din voturi
lithuania.description: Iliana Iotova este pe cale să obțină un mandat de cinci ani la conducerea Bulgariei, potrivit primelor exit-poll-uri publicate la închiderea urnelor. Candidata susținută de formațiunea premierului Rumen Radev conduce în fața lui Andrei Ghiurov, care a mizat pe o platformă pro-occidentală și pe apropierea de UE și NATO, potrivit Novinite.

lithuania.title: Un fost agent Mossad l-ar fi ajutat pe Flavio Bolsonaro să fugă din Brazilia. Cum a fost organizată operațiunea secretă (presă)
lithuania.description: Un fost agent al serviciului israelian de informații Mossad l-ar fi ajutat pe senatorul brazilian Flavio Bolsonaro, fiul fostului președinte Jair Bolsonaro, să fugă din Brazilia prin Argentina, încălcând o interdicție judecătorească de a părăsi țara. Operațiunea ar fi fost pregătită înaintea turului al doilea al alegerilor prezidențiale și ar fi beneficiat de sprijinul unor persoane influente din Argentina și Statele Unite, relatează The Jerusalem Post, preluat de News.ro.

lithuania.title: Marco Rubio neagă o implicare directă a Washingotnului în fuga lui Flavio Bolsonaro din Brazilia
lithuania.description: Secretarul de stat american Marco Rubio a declarat sâmbătă că Washingtonul nu a fost implicat direct în aranjamentele făcute de senatorul Flavio Bolsonaro de a părăsi Brazilia după înfrângerea sa în cel de-al doilea tur al alegerilor prezidenţiale, relatează duminică AFP.

lithuania.title: Obsesia Generației Z pentru ridicatul de greutăți și legătura cu Napoleon. De ce renunță tinerii la alergat pentru sala de forță
lithuania.description: Peste un sfert dintre tinerii adulți din Marea Britanie spun în prezent că abonamentele la sală contează mai mult pentru ei decât vacanțele sau mâncatul în oraș. Datele Sport England arată că Generația Z a început să se îndepărteze de alergare, înot și cursuri de fitness și să se orienteze către sală și antrenamentul de forță. Pentru ei, antrenamentul cu greutăți este considerat cea mai bună formă de exercițiu, pentru că poate ajuta la dezvoltarea forței, la îmbunătățirea aspectului și la îmbunătățirea sănătății generale.

lithuania.description: Četru gadu laikā kopš Krievijas pilna mēroga iebrukuma Ukrainā Latvijas aizsardzības spējas ir būtiski attīstījušās, tomēr valsts nav izmantojusi visas iespējas, lai šo procesu padarītu straujāku un efektīvāku. lithuania.title: Orai.lt: nusimato sausa, bet niūri savaitė
lithuania.description: Antradienio dieną orus lems Skandinavijos anticiklonas, o mes būsime jo pietrytiniame pakraštyje. Dangus bus gausiai padengtas plonų debesų, ir per pragiedrulius vietomis skverbsis saulės spinduliai.

lithuania.title: Rytų Latvijoje paskelbtas perspėjimas dėl grėsmės oro erdvėje
lithuania.description: Latvijos kariuomenė perspėjo Balvų ir Ludzos savivaldybių gyventojus apie grėsmę šalies oro erdvėje. Abi savivaldybės yra rytų Latvijoje, prie sienos su Rusija.

lithuania.title: Per Izraelio atakas Gazos Ruože žuvo penki žmonės
lithuania.description: Gazos Ruože per Izraelio aviacijos smūgius ir šaudymą pirmadienį žuvo penki žmonės, pranešė anklavo civilinės saugos agentūra.

lithuania.title: Auksu tviskančios džiunglės Trumpo rezidencijoje: kaip jis su savo turtingais draugais šventė Heloviną
lithuania.description: Sienos ir stalai buvo išmarginti gepardų bei zebrų kailio raštais. Moterys dėvėjo žvyneliais siuvinėtus triko ir puošnius galvos apdangalus. Viena pora tarp svečių sukiojosi persirengusi ryškiaspalviais džiunglių paukščių plunksnų kostiumais. Tuomet pasirodė Jungtinių Valstijų prezidentas Donaldas Trumpas.

lithuania.title: Prancūzijos kalėjimų perpildymas pasiekė naują rekordą
lithuania.description: Prancūzijos kalinių skaičius praėjusį mėnesį pasiekė naują rekordą ir priartėjo prie 91 tūkst., perpildymui pasiekus visų laikų aukščiausią lygį, rodo pirmadienį paskelbti Teisingumo ministerijos duomenys.

lithuania.title: Vokietijoje teisiamas daugiau nei 70 vaikų seksualiniu prievartavimu kaltinamas gydytojas
lithuania.description: Vokietijos rytuose pirmadienį prieš teismą stojo pediatras, kaltinamas daugiau nei dešimtmetį seksualiai prievartavęs per 70 vaikų – šiuos nusikaltimus gydytojas pripažino pats.

lithuania.title: Arabų lyderis Izraelyje ragina opoziciją vienytis prieš Benjaminą Netanyahu
lithuania.description: Didžiausios būsimojo Izraelio parlamento arabų partijos lyderis pirmadienį naujienų agentūrai AFP pareiškė, kad dvejojantiems opozicijos nariams atėjo laikas pripažinti „politinę realybę“ ir suvienyti jėgas siekiant nuversti ministrą pirmininką Benjaminą Netanyahu (Benjaminą Netanjahu).

lithuania.title: Kilus pasipiktinimui, Vietnamas atsisakė siūlymo leisti vaikų organų donorystę
lithuania.description: Kilus visuomenės pasipiktinimui, Vietnamas pirmadienį atsiėmė siūlymą leisti 15–17 metų vaikams po mirties tapti organų donorais.

lithuania.title: Per Rusijos smūgius pagalbos dalijimo punktui Ukrainoje žuvo 18 žmonių
lithuania.description: Ukrainos pietryčiuose esančiame kaime pirmadienį per Rusijos smūgius žuvo mažiausiai 18 žmonių, pranešė prezidentas Volodymyras Zelenskis.
